title: v1.0.92 Beta — Reports & Performance Update
description: You're on the bleeding edge! This beta release brings a highly requested feature: Daily Report PDF exports, the Day ID search system, and massive performance improvements.
features:
📄 Daily Reports PDF
Export a beautiful Daily Report PDF showing your total study time, sessions, and daily goals, complete with specific Session Types (e.g. Revision, Class, YouTube).

🔍 Day ID Search
Every daily report now includes a unique Day ID (e.g. DAY-20260816). Paste this into the global search bar to instantly see a beautiful dashboard summarizing that exact day!

⚡ Blazing Fast Performance
We squashed major memory leaks and overhauled the rendering engine. Switching tabs and viewing large amounts of study analytics is now incredibly smooth and fast!

📅 Schedule Upcoming Mocks
Plan out your mock exams! You can now schedule upcoming mock exams, see a countdown on your dashboard, and keep track of them in your Planner.
